findings.detail: Adhefin International subordinated term loan has source-disclosed PIK interest but the extracted private-credit row has blank interest_rate and basis_spread.

citation.quoted_text: Subordinated Term Loan | EURIBOR + 10.5 % PIK, 14.4 % PIK

rationale: X02 flags private-credit rows with no interest_rate or basis_spread. The bundle's holdings sample includes Adhefin International, Industrial Other, Subordinated Term Loan with blank interest_rate, but the raw schedule row immediately under Adhefin International discloses an Interest value of EURIBOR + 10.5 % PIK, 14.4 % PIK. This grounds the warning as a real extraction gap rather than source absence or a false alarm.
